data.animaCaption: Standing on the left of the frame, she extends an oversized silver revolver straight toward the right foreground in dramatic foreshortening. Vivid cyan rim light from floating magic circles outlines her swirling cape and silver hair against the deep purple starfield.
data.promptProse: Rendered in a dramatic wide visual-novel event composition with extreme perspective foreshortening, Ayachi Nene stands poised on the left wearing her canonical witch outfit—striped-ribbon pointed hat, billowing pink-lined black cape, criss-cross halter crop top, and pink-striped wrist cuffs. She extends one arm straight toward the right foreground, aiming an ornate oversized silver revolver directly at the camera with fierce determination as her silver hair floats weightlessly. Behind her stretches a vast indigo-purple starfield laced with rotating cyan magic circles and drifting luminous particles that carve sharp electric rim light around her silhouette.
data.story: 星海与旋转的青蓝色魔法阵在脚下铺展。披风翻飞的宁宁抬臂将沉重的银色左轮直指前方，平日的羞怯全然褪去，紫眸里烧着守护珍视之人的决绝锋芒。
